question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/solar-watts-to-recharge-power-station — What's the cheapest 400 W portable panel here, and which stations will it work with?

replays.text:
The cheapest is the **ALLPOWERS SP037 400 W foldable panel**: **$299**, or **$269.10 with code ALLPOWERS26**. [Buy the SP037](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel).

It works with the stations listed on the page **except the Tenergy T320 and BLUETTI Elite 30 V2**, whose solar-input voltage limits are too low for the panel’s 45.3 V open-circuit voltage. Compatible models listed include the ALLPOWERS R600, P1800, S2000 Pro and R4000, plus the BLUETTI AC180, AC200L, Elite 200 V2 and Elite 300. [Panel specs and compatibility notes](https://dealectric.com/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel).
